columns.leak_node: junction where the leak is (answer for location)
columns.leak_pipes: pipes connected to that junction, separated by |
columns.leak_x / leak_y: leak position in metres (UTM 40S), for distance error
columns.leak_coeff: EPANET emitter coefficient used (leak size setting)
columns.leak_flow_lps: leak flow at the first recorded hour, L/s (answer for size)
columns.water_lost_m3_day_est: leak_flow_lps x 86.4, rough m3 per day
columns.demand_scale: random change in total water use for this scenario
columns.inflow_change_lps_hXX: zone inlet meter change vs normal day at hour XX
columns.dp_mm_hXX_<sensor>: pressure drop at that sensor vs normal day, mm (positive = pressure fell), includes sensor noise

note: Simulated with EPANET via WNTR on an illustrative network. Leaks are modelled as emitters at junctions. Not real CWA data.
